title: Postcard Condition Review Freshness
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:postcard storage_box=* last_review_epoch=* snapshot_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((snapshot_epoch-last_review_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by storage_box
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures condition-review freshness by storage box for postcard preservation.
value: Lag tracking shows which storage box create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside postcard preservation.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `condition-review freshness` on `memory:postcard` events and aggregate them by `storage_box`.
visualization: Table of storage box with average and worst condition-review freshness.
grandmaExplanation: It turns how long things take for each storage box so you can see where postcard preservation slows down.
